quotes.text: 268 form a held-out split (2,536 instances) whose labels are accessible only through our scorer
providing direct evidence that Synthetic Hospital does not favor the model family used during data generation

parsed.rationale: A held-out split is the developer-side control, and a measured check is reported (generator re-rendering robustness test, plus the 54% held-out/training diagnosis overlap). Note: the README says the held-out reference labels are shipped for local scoring, which undercuts the paper's statement that labels are accessible only through the scorer.
